notes.note: Reviewed final source actions/privacy delta: shared ActionRow keeps Refresh and Enable/Disable as two labelled buttons and moves removal to named danger overflow; loading uses the canonical Skeleton family. Responsive inventory retains explicit pending root geometry proof rather than claiming browser/native qualification. The source scanner now recognizes literal plugin catalog reads, Skill discovery is caller-projected and the named install mutation has its specific non-enumeration rationale. Real SkillService discovery for legacy plugin and portable Agent Plugin sources reproduced hidden installed-name-conflict on the pre-fix route; overlay now extracts the exact owner and checks caller visibility after asynchronous public catalog reads. Both owner-specific controls and revocation during that read pass; provided/private ownership supplies no hidden installed/status signals. New /skills overlay is covered; inherited /skills/installed is separate. Executed four static gates, 73 source/UI/identity tests and final 25 marketplace/source-action tests green. Prior review scope and all hosted/private-provider/native/release limits are preserved.
